description: Implementation tasks for the PC parts overhaul. Execute without destructive database operations.

tasks.description: Capture the current PC-parts, quote, build, and admin behavior before changes.
tasks.reason: The overhaul spans shared data and user flows and needs a reproducible comparison point.
tasks.requirements: Snapshot the relevant source and test behavior without changing the database. Record focused test, typecheck, and build commands plus external-service assumptions.

tasks.description: Add category-specific PC-part normalizers and deterministic derivation rules.
tasks.reason: Imported parts need consistent fields for compatibility, pricing, search, and build generation.
tasks.requirements: Define category-specific normalization and derivation behavior for the supported PC-part categories. Add representative fixtures, invalid-input coverage, and regression tests. Keep source/raw fields available for auditability and do not alter unrelated catalog behavior.

tasks.description: Make PC-part seed/reseed idempotent, ownership-safe, and storage-split.
tasks.reason: Repeated imports must converge without overwriting administrator-owned fields or requiring destructive wipes.
tasks.requirements: Use deterministic identity and idempotent upserts. Separate imported/source data from admin-owned catalog data while preserving existing ownership fields and compatibility. Add dry-run/reporting behavior, repeat-run tests, conflict handling, and explicit safeguards against destructive database operations.

tasks.description: Improve admin pagination, bulk operations, CSV support, and build settings.
tasks.reason: Administrators need scalable catalog workflows and safe control of generator configuration.
tasks.requirements: Provide server-backed pagination and filtering, safe bulk actions with authorization and auditability, validated CSV import/export behavior, and admin management for build settings/profiles. Preserve existing single-record operations and validate malformed or oversized input.

tasks.description: Apply shared rate limiting to public and sensitive API flows.
tasks.reason: Shared protection is needed across quote, build, contact, upload, and admin-sensitive endpoints.
tasks.requirements: Centralize rate-limit policy and response behavior, apply it consistently to relevant routes, preserve legitimate admin and customer workflows, and make limits/configuration testable. Do not expose secrets or rely on process-local state where production deployment requires shared coordination.

tasks.description: Add quote budget flow, part swaps, live refresh, and over-budget state.
tasks.reason: Customers need transparent control of build cost while compatibility and quote totals remain accurate.
tasks.requirements: Support setting and editing a budget, swapping compatible parts, refreshing catalog/pricing data without losing valid user state, and clearly representing under-, in-, and over-budget outcomes. Preserve compatibility warnings, quantities, tax calculations, and quote submission behavior.

tasks.description: Keep quote and PDF output aligned with build context.
tasks.reason: Generated builds and downloadable/customer-facing quotes must reflect the same selections, budget, pricing, and context.
tasks.requirements: Propagate build platform, profile, budget, selected swaps, catalog version, customer/tax context, and over-budget state consistently through quote persistence and PDF generation. Preserve existing PDF validity and avoid embedding environment-specific secrets or unstable data.

tasks.description: Build property, performance, and integration tests for the generator and overhaul flows.
tasks.reason: The generator combines normalized data, compatibility, budgets, pricing, and persistence boundaries that need broader validation than examples alone.
tasks.requirements: Add deterministic property-based coverage for generator invariants, performance checks with representative catalog sizes, and integration tests covering normalization-to-generation, admin settings, quote refresh/swaps, persistence, and PDF context. Tests must avoid destructive databases and use isolated fixtures/mocks or an explicitly documented emulator.

tasks.description: Document the safe operational runbook for catalog and quote operations.
tasks.reason: Operators need repeatable procedures for seeding, reseeding, CSV workflows, verification, rollback, and incident recovery.
tasks.requirements: Document prerequisites, environment variables, dry-run and reseed procedures, ownership-preservation guarantees, backup/restore expectations, rate-limit operations, build/quote verification, failure handling, rollback boundaries, and the prohibition on destructive wipes. Include focused validation commands: npm test, npx tsc --noEmit, and npm run build.
